how_to_apply: Visit the online recruitment portal at gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php.
Ensure you meet the required qualifications for advertisement number NIHE/SRC-05/26-27.
Submit your application through the online recruitment portal on or before 11:59 PM on 23rd October 2026.
Keep a printout or copy of the submitted application for future reference.
Bring original documents pertaining to educational qualifications and experience along with one set of photocopies if appearing for a physical interview.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted exclusively through the online recruitment portal before 11:59 PM on 23rd October 2026. Minimum requirements of qualifications and/or experience can be relaxed for exceptionally outstanding candidates. Candidates appearing for an interview physically must bring original documents and one set of photocopies. Experience will not be considered without an official experience certificate. Selected candidates are expected to join immediately and are liable to be posted anywhere in India. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview. The Institute reserves the right to disengage manpower at any time without assigning reasons and to increase or decrease the number of positions. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification.

content_sections.heading: GBPIHED Junior Project Fellow Important Dates
GBPIHED Junior Project Fellow Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available under the MoEF&CC, NATCOM project titled “Preparation of Biennial Transparency Report (BTR-3) on Climate Change Impacts, Risks, Vulnerabilities, Adaptation and Loss & Damage in the Indian Himalayan Ecosystem”.

rows.position_emoluments: Junior Project Fellow (@ Rs. 24,000/- +HRA per month)

content_sections.heading: GBPIHED Junior Project Fellow Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from Indian citizens.

rows.qualification_required: Essential: First class Master Degree in Botany/ Environmental Science/ Forestry/ Statistics/Climate Science.Desirable: Preference will be given to candidates with experience in biodiversity & forest assessment, and climate change impact study; Knowledge of Statistics, and data handling, climate change modelling; Good report writing, data synthesization, communication, and presentation skills.

content_sections.text: The age limit for the Junior Project Fellow post is 28 Years .

content_sections.text: The selection process includes short-listing of candidates followed by the mode of interview, date, and time which will be informed separately.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Original educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Experience certificate (mandatory if claiming experience) One set of photocopies of all required documents

content_sections.heading: Junior Project Fellow Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted exclusively through the online recruitment portal before 11:59 PM on 23rd October 2026. Minimum requirements of qualifications and/or experience can be relaxed for exceptionally outstanding candidates. Candidates appearing for an interview physically must bring original documents and one set of photocopies. Experience will not be considered without an official experience certificate. Selected candidates are expected to join immediately and are liable to be posted anywhere in India. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview. The Institute reserves the right to disengage manpower at any time without assigning reasons and to increase or decrease the number of positions. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization recruiting for the Junior Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (NIHE), Sikkim Regional Centre Pangthang, Gangtok.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Project Fellow post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications online is 23rd October 2026 up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First class Master Degree in Botany, Environmental Science, Forestry, Statistics, or Climate Science.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Junior Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 28 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 24,000/- +HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official recruitment portal at gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php.

faq.question: Q9. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The short-listed candidates will be informed separately about the mode of interview, date, and time.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent position?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely project-based and temporary in nature under the MoEF&CC, NATCOM project.
